articles.title: Security Firm Wins Prison Service Contract For Electronic Monitoring
articles.description: Israeli company SuperCom, which provides security solutions for digital operations, has been awarded a five-year contract by the government-run Israel Prison Service (IPS) to deploy its PureSecurity Electronic Monitoring (EM) Suite, alongside its prime partner Electra.
